evidence.quoted_text:
function liveUnitExitCode(command: string, result: OpResult<unknown>): number {
  if (result.status !== 'ok') return 1;
evidence.reason: The finding's old line 93 was refactored, but the defect persists at the current tip: liveUnitExitCode maps every non-ok live-unit status to exit 1. LiveDispatchResult permits an OpResult carrying `needs-human`, so a dispatch returning `{ status: 'needs-human', reason: ... }` without an explicit exitCode is reported as 1 instead of the I1 needs-human code 3. This is an implementation error in existing exit-code behavior, not a new requirement.
